metadata.case_name: LAU TSZ HA v. CHUI SANG CHOY AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Full-time kindergarten teacher and part-time lecturer (VTC/LWL, Chinese University, Hong Kong Polytechnic University)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Field work supervisor, book writer and freelance speaker (academic year 2009/2010)

injuries.description: fracture with displacement of the upper end of humerus at right shoulder
source: X-ray showed fracture with displacement of the upper end of humerus (arm bone) at right shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of humerus, unspecified site

source: There was also abrasion on bridge of nose and the right knee.
There was also abrasion on bridge of nose and the right knee.

manifestations.description: pain and weakness over the right shoulder and upper arm
residual pain and stiffness in right shoulder
difficulty in writing on and cleaning the white board
difficulty lifting children (including inability to lift above head in some situations)
pain radiating to the little finger
reduced ability to carry things for a long time
sleep disturbance (affected sleep; sometimes needed sleeping pills)

treatments_received: private orthopaedic treatment for about 6 months
instructed not to move shoulders for 5 months
general outpatient treatment at government family clinics
physiotherapy (10 sessions over 3 months up to December 2004)

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Unable to clean windows and needs to arrange alternatives for domestic tasks

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Stopped swimming, playing the hula-hoop and badminton
Unable to continue full-time kindergarten teaching and loss/non-renewal of pre-accident part-time lecturing jobs
